card.name: Bachatango
card.tagline: Fusion of Dominican bachata with Argentine tango moves.
card.profile: Bachatango is a fusion style combining the four-step Dominican bachata with Argentine tango elements - kicks, dips, turns, ganchos, leg wraps, and long pauses - characterized by sensual hip movements; partners hold a closed position with inner-thigh contact (English Wikipedia). It originated among dance instructors in Turin, Italy, was once popular in foreign ballrooms, and is now rare on social floors.
card.insight: Bachatango exemplifies the early-2000s 'Bachata Fusion' trend in which dancers blended bachata with tango, salsa, and zouk; it is essentially unknown in the Dominican Republic, bachata's homeland (English Wikipedia).
